manifest.purpose: The golden answer file for the analysis_report submission. Contains the exact hierarchical name of the shared enable signal (common_mode_node) and a precise description of the failure mechanism (failure_mechanism) that matches the ground truth: faulting shared_count_en low stalls both counters identically, so their equality monitor remains satisfied while timeout never asserts. This file is placed at golden/vulnerability_report.json and will be overlaid onto submission/vulnerability_report.json during grading. The evaluator reads this file and compares its content against the hidden acceptance criteria.
